imprest.title: Ufadhili wa imprest
imprest.description: Maombi ya fedha za uendeshaji, kiasi ambacho Mkurugenzi aliidhinisha na kukabidhi, na kiasi ambacho Meneja alithibitisha kupokea.

total.label: Ufadhili wa imprest uliothibitishwa
total.help: Jumla ya ufadhili ambao Meneja amethibitisha kuupokea. Si hesabu ya fedha taslimu, na matumizi bado hayarekodiwi hapa.
total.noFund: Bado hakuna ombi la ufadhili wa imprest.

help.provide: Kinaweza kuwa chini ya kilichoidhinishwa. Ili kukabidhi zaidi, rekodi kwanza ongezeko la idhini.

success.approved: Ufadhili umeidhinishwa. Hakuna kinachowekwa hadi Meneja athibitishe kupokea.
success.provided: Makabidhiano yamerekodiwa. Yatawekwa tu Meneja atakapoyathibitisha.
success.received: Upokeaji wa fedha umethibitishwa na kuwekwa.
success.corrected: Makabidhiano sahihi yamerekodiwa. Meneja lazima ayathibitishe.

detail.awaitingManager: Inasubiri Meneja athibitishe makabidhiano au aripoti tofauti.
